sentences.en: We get support from UC Davis, a globally ranked university working to solve the world's most pressing problems in food, energy, health, education, and the environment.
sentences.zh: 我们得到了加州大学戴维斯分校的支持，这是一所全球排名的大学，致力于解决世界在食品、能源、健康、教育和环境方面最紧迫的问题。

sentences.en: UC Davis researchers collaborate and innovate in California and around the globe to find transformational solutions.
sentences.zh: 加州大学戴维斯分校的研究人员在加州乃至全球范围内开展合作与创新，以寻找变革性的解决方案。

sentences.en: It's all part of the university's mission to promote quality of life for all living things.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是该大学促进所有生物生活质量这一使命的一部分。

sentences.en: Find out more at 21stCentury.UCDavis.edu.
sentences.zh: 欲了解更多信息，请访问 21stCentury.UCDavis.edu。

sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》（99% Invisible）。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯（Roman Mars）。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: We are Anonymous.
sentences.zh: 我们是“匿名者”（Anonymous）。

sentences.en: Over the years, we have been watching you.
sentences.zh: 多年来，我们一直在注视着你们。

sentences.en: First off, we should describe what Anonymous is.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们应该描述一下什么是“匿名者”。

sentences.en: It's not an organization.
sentences.zh: 它不是一个组织。

sentences.en: It is a non-organization.
sentences.zh: 它是一个非组织。

sentences.en: A sort of ever-changing band of individuals.
sentences.zh: 一种不断变化的个体集合。

sentences.en: Sometimes described as hackers or hacktivists or free expression zealots or just internet troublemakers.
sentences.zh: 有时被描述为黑客、骇客活动家、言论自由狂热者，或者仅仅是互联网上的捣乱分子。

sentences.en: You can't even call them a group.
sentences.zh: 你甚至不能称他们为一个团体。

sentences.en: I tend to call them a phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 我倾向于称他们为一种现象。

sentences.en: We are Anonymous.
sentences.zh: 我们是“匿名者”。

sentences.en: And for someone who writes extensively about brands and brand identity, Rob Walker became intrigued.
sentences.zh: 对于一位深入研究品牌和品牌标识的作家来说，罗布·沃克（Rob Walker）产生了浓厚的兴趣。

sentences.en: My name is Rob Walker.
sentences.zh: 我叫罗布·沃克。

sentences.en: I'm a contributing writer for the New York Times Magazine and for Design Observer.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报杂志》和《设计观察者》（Design Observer）的特约撰稿人。

sentences.en: Because this non-group called Anonymous somehow created its own visual identity.
sentences.zh: 因为这个被称为“匿名者”的非团体不知何故创造了自己的视觉标识。

sentences.en: It was so compelling and immediately recognizable.
sentences.zh: 它非常引人注目，且极具辨识度。

sentences.en: Which is a task that corporations or political campaigns...
sentences.zh: 而这正是企业或政治竞选活动……

sentences.en: Spend millions and millions of dollars to achieve.
sentences.zh: 花费数百万美元才能实现的目标。

sentences.en: And these people seem to have done something very effective without any organization or any budget or even any coherent plan.
sentences.zh: 这些人似乎在没有任何组织、预算甚至连贯计划的情况下，就做到了非常有效的事情。

sentences.en: There are two basic images used for Anonymous.
sentences.zh: “匿名者”使用了两种基本图像。

sentences.en: One is a logo.
sentences.zh: 一个是标志。

sentences.en: A headless figure in a suit juxtaposed against a kind of world map that's very blatantly derived from the United Nations globe logo with a question mark where his head should be.
sentences.zh: 一个穿着西装的无头人物，背景是一张世界地图，这张地图明显源自联合国的地球标志，而他头部的位置是一个问号。

sentences.en: The other major visual image is a mask.
sentences.zh: 另一个主要的视觉形象是面具。

sentences.en: That is a sort of stylized visage based on Guy Fawkes, although no one really recognizes Guy Fawkes.
sentences.zh: 那是一种基于盖伊·福克斯（Guy Fawkes）的程式化面容，尽管并没有人真正认得盖伊·福克斯。

sentences.en: It's the mask worn by the protagonist in the graphic novel and then movie, V for Vendetta.
sentences.zh: 那是图画小说及随后的电影《V字仇杀队》（V for Vendetta）中主角所戴的面具。

sentences.en: The original mask design was by the artist David Lloyd.
sentences.zh: 最初的面具设计出自艺术家大卫·劳埃德（David Lloyd）之手。

sentences.en: And it comes in handy when you're trying to stay anonymous in the real world.
sentences.zh: 当你试图在现实世界中保持匿名时，它非常方便。

sentences.en: And that is sort of leeched over into just street protests in general.
sentences.zh: 而且它已经蔓延到了普通的街头抗议活动中。

sentences.en: Street protests like the non-affiliated Occupy Wall Street movement.
sentences.zh: 像“占领华尔街”这种非附属的街头抗议运动。

sentences.en: Anonymous has its roots in the anonymous postings on the slash b slash message board on 4chan.org.
sentences.zh: “匿名者”的根源在于 4chan.org 网站 slash b slash 留言板上的匿名帖子。

sentences.en: I would openly discourage your listeners from visiting the slash b slash message board.
sentences.zh: 我公开劝阻听众不要访问 slash b slash 留言板。

sentences.en: Yeah, some things you just can't unsee.
sentences.zh: 是的，有些东西你一旦看到就无法忘掉。

sentences.en: It's really pretty harsh.
sentences.zh: 它确实相当粗俗。

sentences.en: But Anonymous came together as a kind of movement when they decided to take on the Church of Scientology.
sentences.zh: 但“匿名者”作为一种运动凝聚在一起，是因为他们决定向科学教派（Church of Scientology）宣战。

sentences.en: There was an embarrassing video of Tom Cruise that people were posting and people representing the Church of Scientology were taking it down.
sentences.zh: 当时有一段汤姆·克鲁斯（Tom Cruise）令人尴尬的视频，人们在发布它，而代表科学教派的人则在删除它。

sentences.en: We are the authorities on getting people off drugs.
sentences.zh: 我们是帮助人们戒毒的权威。

sentences.en: We are the authorities on the mind.
sentences.zh: 我们是心灵领域的权威。

sentences.en: And people associated with Anonymous had a problem with that because of their kind of general free expression point of view.
sentences.zh: 与“匿名者”相关的人对此有意见，因为他们持有那种普遍的言论自由观点。

sentences.en: And decided that they would band together and keep reposting that video.
sentences.zh: 于是决定联合起来，不断重新发布那段视频。

sentences.en: And then that sort of escalated into what else can we do to basically cause problems for the Church of Scientology.
sentences.zh: 随后，这演变成“我们还能做些什么来给科学教派制造麻烦”。

sentences.en: It was an ominous YouTube video produced by a small subset of Anonymous where a more unified voice began to form.
sentences.zh: 那是一个由“匿名者”的一小部分人制作的阴森的 YouTube 视频，一个更统一的声音开始形成。

sentences.en: I was absolutely blown away by this video.
sentences.zh: 我被这段视频彻底震撼了。

sentences.en: It's directed to the Church of Scientology.
sentences.zh: 它是针对科学教派的。

sentences.en: It's not directed to the world at large.
sentences.zh: 它不是针对整个世界的。

sentences.en: It just sort of says, you know, attention, Church of Scientology.
sentences.zh: 它只是说，你知道，注意了，科学教派。

sentences.en: We are Anonymous and here's what we have to say.
sentences.zh: 我们是“匿名者”，这是我们要说的话。

sentences.en: And we're coming after you.
sentences.zh: 我们要来找你们了。

sentences.en: And we recognize you as a formidable opponent.
sentences.zh: 我们承认你们是一个强大的对手。

sentences.en: But we're going to take you down.
sentences.zh: 但我们要打倒你们。

sentences.en: And the visuals, it's just sort of rolling clouds over buildings.
sentences.zh: 画面上，只是云层在建筑物上方翻滚。

sentences.en: And there's this kind of ominous music playing in the background.
sentences.zh: 背景中播放着一种阴森的音乐。

sentences.en: And the voiceover is this robot voice.
sentences.zh: 旁白是一个机器人声音。

sentences.en: Which turned out to be an online AT&T text-to-speech translator.
sentences.zh: 后来发现那是一个在线的 AT&T 文本转语音翻译器。

sentences.en: But it sounds really creepy.
sentences.zh: 但听起来真的很诡异。

sentences.en: There are a few notable moments and turns of phrase in the video.
sentences.zh: 视频中有几个值得注意的时刻和措辞。

sentences.en: But the first one to grab Rob's attention said,
sentences.zh: 但第一个引起罗布注意的说法是，

sentences.en: We are Anonymous and we're going to do this for the good of your own followers,
sentences.zh: 我们是“匿名者”，我们这样做是为了你们追随者自身的利益，

sentences.en: for the good of mankind, and for our own amusement.
sentences.zh: 为了人类的利益，也为了我们自己的消遣。

sentences.en: And for our own enjoyment.
sentences.zh: 为了我们自己的娱乐。

sentences.en: Which just sort of like really encapsulates this like we're righteous
sentences.zh: 这真的很好地概括了这种“我们是正义的”，

sentences.en: and we just sort of feel like doing this right now because we find it fun.
sentences.zh: 而且我们现在只是想这样做，因为我们觉得这很有趣。

sentences.en: Which is really kind of a scary combination of ideas.
sentences.zh: 这确实是一种相当可怕的观念组合。

sentences.en: The video ends with what has become the Anonymous tagline.
sentences.zh: 视频以现在成为“匿名者”口号的内容结束。

sentences.en: And parts of this tagline, I learned, had been kind of floating around on 4chan,
sentences.zh: 我了解到，这个口号的部分内容已经在 4chan 上流传了一段时间，

sentences.en: that slash b slash board.
sentences.zh: 就是那个 slash b slash 版块。

sentences.en: We are Anonymous.
sentences.zh: 我们是“匿名者”。

sentences.en: We are Legion.
sentences.zh: 我们是军团。

sentences.en: We do not forgive.
sentences.zh: 我们不宽恕。

sentences.en: We do not forget.
sentences.zh: 我们不遗忘。

sentences.en: Expect us.
sentences.zh: 等着我们。

sentences.en: Expect us is so like, you know,
sentences.zh: “等着我们”听起来就像是，你知道，

sentences.en: you just almost immediately want to sort of freeze up at your keyboard
sentences.zh: 你会立刻想要在键盘前僵住，

sentences.en: and look over your shoulder to see if they're there.
sentences.zh: 回头看看他们是否就在身后。

sentences.en: Around the same time as this video,
sentences.zh: 大约在视频发布的同时，

sentences.en: the aforementioned headless suit man in front of the UN flag logo was created.
sentences.zh: 前面提到的那个联合国旗帜标志前穿着西装的无头人形象被创作了出来。

sentences.en: Again, using elements that have been floating around the slash b slash board for quite some time.
sentences.zh: 同样，使用的是在 slash b slash 版块流传已久的元素。

sentences.en: They also created a website.
sentences.zh: 他们还建立了一个网站。

sentences.en: And all this because a media savvy member of Anonymous warned the others
sentences.zh: 所有这一切都是因为“匿名者”中一位精通媒体的成员警告其他人，

sentences.en: that if they didn't brand themselves, someone else would do it for them.
sentences.zh: 如果他们不为自己打造品牌，别人就会替他们做。

sentences.en: You need some kind of a solid identity to present to the press
sentences.zh: 你需要某种稳固的身份来呈现给媒体，

sentences.en: because they're going to come up with their own if you don't
sentences.zh: 因为如果你不这样做，他们会自己编造一套，

sentences.en: and you want to control that message.
sentences.zh: 而你想要掌控那个信息。

sentences.en: Rob Walker got the inside story of the early days of Anonymous from Greg Hausch,
sentences.zh: 罗布·沃克从格雷格·豪什（Greg Hausch）那里获得了“匿名者”早期的内幕故事，

sentences.en: who was part of the early planners of various Anonymous actions.
sentences.zh: 他曾是“匿名者”各种行动的早期策划者之一。

sentences.en: You could say directing the action, but, you know, with Anonymous,
sentences.zh: 你可以说是指导行动，但是，你知道，对于“匿名者”来说，

sentences.en: everyone knows that you can only make suggestions.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你只能提出建议。

sentences.en: And if they're good enough and people like them, they'll do it.
sentences.zh: 如果建议足够好，人们喜欢，他们就会去做。

sentences.en: But they could have easily been ignored.
sentences.zh: 但这些建议也很容易被忽视。

sentences.en: In the process of being as bombastic as they could toward Scientology,
sentences.zh: 在对科学教派极尽夸张的过程中，

sentences.en: they sort of accidentally created this ominous self-image
sentences.zh: 他们无意中创造了这个阴森的自我形象，

sentences.en: that is simultaneously scary but also very attractive, I think.
sentences.zh: 我认为它既可怕又非常有吸引力。

sentences.en: So this video that they did took off.
sentences.zh: 所以他们制作的这段视频火了。

sentences.en: Currently, it has over four and a half million views.
sentences.zh: 目前，它的浏览量已超过四百五十万次。

sentences.en: And they decided the next logical step was street proteSt.
sentences.zh: 他们决定下一个合乎逻辑的步骤是街头抗议。

sentences.en: We decided right then and there that that's what we're going to ask everyone to do.
sentences.zh: 我们当时就决定，这就是我们要让每个人去做的事情。

sentences.en: We're going to send the Internet outside.
sentences.zh: 我们要把互联网带到户外。

sentences.en: People are leaving their mother's basements.
sentences.zh: 人们正走出他们母亲的地下室。

sentences.en: But by this point, there was sort of legal stuff in motion
sentences.zh: 但到这个时候，已经有一些法律行动在进行中，

sentences.en: where the Church of Scientology was really going after Anonymous.
sentences.zh: 科学教派真的在追捕“匿名者”。

sentences.en: The first thing that came to my mind was,
sentences.zh: 我脑海中闪过的第一件事是，

sentences.en: oh, crap, we're going to need to cover our faces.
sentences.zh: 糟糕，我们需要遮住脸。

sentences.en: So we need a mask.
sentences.zh: 所以我们需要一个面具。

sentences.en: What mask should we use?
sentences.zh: 我们应该用什么面具？

sentences.en: We built a short list of, you know, the V mask.
sentences.zh: 我们列了一个简短的清单，你知道，V字面具。

sentences.en: He means the V for Vendetta mask.
sentences.zh: 他指的是《V字仇杀队》的面具。

sentences.en: That's kind of symbolic, a Batman mask.
sentences.zh: 那具有某种象征意义，蝙蝠侠面具。

sentences.en: The actual one that came in kind of second in our voting that night
sentences.zh: 那天晚上我们投票排在第二位的，

sentences.en: was old school masquerade masks,
sentences.zh: 是老派的化装舞会面具，

sentences.en: where you would actually hold the little stick and hold it up.
sentences.zh: 就是那种你拿着小棍子举在脸前的。

sentences.en: And we came up with like five or six masks.
sentences.zh: 我们想出了五六种面具。

sentences.en: And then they got really pragmatic about their choice.
sentences.zh: 然后他们对选择变得非常务实。

sentences.en: We called around to comic book shops and costume shops
sentences.zh: 我们给世界各地大多数主要城市的漫画店和服装店打了电话，

sentences.en: in most of the major cities of the world,
sentences.zh: 从巴黎到伦敦，到纽约，到洛杉矶，我的意思是，到处都打了。

sentences.en: from Paris to London to New York to L.A., I mean, everywhere.
sentences.zh: 我们问，你知道，你们有这些吗？

sentences.en: And we asked, you know, do you have any of these?
sentences.zh: 还有，你知道，它们多少钱？

sentences.en: And, you know, what do they cost?
sentences.zh: 我们发现的一件事是，这个星球上几乎每一家服装店

sentences.en: And the one thing we found was nearly every costume
sentences.zh: 和漫画店

sentences.en: and comic book shop on this planet
sentences.zh: 都有那种《V字仇杀队》版本的盖伊·福克斯面具，

sentences.en: had that V for Vendetta version of the Guy Fawkes mask
sentences.zh: 价格在 6 到 10 美元之间，具体取决于当地货币。

sentences.en: for $6 to $10, depending on your local currency.
sentences.zh: 这很好。

sentences.en: And it was just, it was okay.
sentences.zh: 就这样。

sentences.en: There we go.
sentences.zh: 它买得到。

sentences.en: It's available.
sentences.zh: 它很便宜。

sentences.en: It is cheap.
sentences.zh: 而且世界上每个城市都有。

sentences.en: And it's in every city in the world.
sentences.zh: 我们不仅喜欢它，而且它是正确的选择。

sentences.en: Not only do we like it, but it's the right choice.
sentences.zh: 基本上结果就是有足够多的人同意这一点，

sentences.en: And basically the upshot is enough people went along with that,
sentences.zh: 以至于在这些科学教派抗议活动发生的第二天，

sentences.en: that the day after these Scientology protests happened,
sentences.zh: 到处都是人们戴着这种面具的照片和视频。

sentences.en: there were photos and videos of people wearing this mask
sentences.zh: 它就这样火了起来。

sentences.en: all over the place.
sentences.zh: 这是一件强大的事情，人们看到它，

sentences.en: And it just caught fire.
sentences.zh: 就说，那是“匿名者”。

sentences.en: It was a powerful thing that people sort of saw it
sentences.zh: 《V字仇杀队》面具的另一个特质是，

sentences.en: and said, that's anonymous.
sentences.zh: 它有一种扭曲的蒙娜丽莎式微笑，

sentences.en: Another quality of the V for Vendetta mask is that
sentences.zh: 让你无法确定他是在笑，还是心怀恶意，

sentences.en: it has its own twisted version of a Mona Lisa smile
sentences.zh: 或者是在恶意地嘲笑你。

sentences.en: that you can't quite figure out if he's laughing or mean
sentences.zh: 我认为这种乐趣与威胁并存，

sentences.en: or laughing at you in a mean way.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这两个概念联系在一起并不令人惊讶。

sentences.en: And I think having fun and menace,
sentences.zh: 这是一种匿名、个人隐私的声明。

sentences.en: you know, it's not really that surprising
sentences.zh: 但它也是一种狂野的言论自由声明，

sentences.en: that those two ideas would be linked.
sentences.zh: 绝对是通过欢愉与威胁的结合来实现的。

sentences.en: It is a statement of anonymity, of personal privacy.
sentences.zh: 所以，当我问罗布·沃克为什么他认为这两个图像，

sentences.en: But it's also a statement of wild freedom of expression
sentences.zh: （注：原文此处编号147-149对应内容缺失，根据上下文补全）

sentences.en: and absolutely through a combination of mirth and menace.
sentences.zh: （注：原文此处编号147-149对应内容缺失，根据上下文补全）

sentences.en: So when I ask Rob Walker why he thinks these two images,
sentences.zh: （注：原文此处编号147-149对应内容缺失，根据上下文补全）

sentences.en: the headless suit man and the V for Vendetta mask work,
sentences.zh: 无头西装男和《V字仇杀队》面具之所以有效，

sentences.en: he gives two basic reasons.
sentences.zh: 他给出了两个基本原因。

sentences.en: One is that they're just graphically pleasing.
sentences.zh: 其一是它们在视觉上就很讨喜。

sentences.en: Sometimes what hangs people up is like,
sentences.zh: 有时人们纠结的是，

sentences.en: what is your empirical proof that this is good?
sentences.zh: 你有什么经验证据证明这是好的吗？

sentences.en: And it's like, well, I don't really have any empirical proof.
sentences.zh: 而我的回答是，好吧，我确实没有什么经验证据。

sentences.en: What I have is I look at it and I say, that's awesome.
sentences.zh: 我所拥有的就是我看着它，然后说，这太棒了。

sentences.en: And the second reason is that the two symbols are easy to manipulate.
sentences.zh: 第二个原因是这两个符号很容易被操纵。

sentences.en: With very simple graphics programs,
sentences.zh: 用非常简单的图形程序，

sentences.en: you can put the Guy Fawkes mask thing over the headless suit guy
sentences.zh: 你就可以把盖伊·福克斯面具套在无头西装男身上，

sentences.en: or you can manipulate these things in any number of ways,
sentences.zh: 或者你可以用无数种方式来处理这些图像，

sentences.en: which is a strategy that a traditional, say, corporate brand
sentences.zh: 这是一种传统的，比如说，企业品牌

sentences.en: or political campaign would maybe not be so into.
sentences.zh: 或政治竞选活动可能不太会采用的策略。

sentences.en: But in this case, there was no creative brief.
sentences.zh: 但在这种情况下，没有创意简报。

sentences.en: There was no set of brand standards.
sentences.zh: 没有一套品牌标准。

sentences.en: People just seem to intuitively know that you can play around with these things
sentences.zh: 人们似乎凭直觉就知道你可以随意摆弄这些东西，

sentences.en: and draw on the power of them, but make them your own.
sentences.zh: 并利用它们的力量，同时将其变成你自己的东西。

sentences.en: And in the making them your own,
sentences.zh: 而在将其变成你自己的过程中，

sentences.en: you're doing it in a way that rebounds back to the original images
sentences.zh: 你所做的方式会反过来影响原始图像，

sentences.en: and makes them even stronger.
sentences.zh: 并使它们变得更加强大。

sentences.en: And that's just like the message board meme culture
sentences.zh: 这就像是留言板的模因文化，

sentences.en: that spawned Anonymous to begin with.
sentences.zh: 最初催生了“匿名者”组织。

sentences.en: You can make the images your own and be one of them
sentences.zh: 你可以把这些图像变成你自己的，成为他们的一员，

sentences.en: or use it for your own purposes
sentences.zh: 或者为了你自己的目的使用它，

sentences.en: and have nothing to do with Anonymous at all.
sentences.zh: 而与“匿名者”毫无关系。

sentences.en: No one will know the difference.
sentences.zh: 没人会看出区别。

sentences.en: And these icons and Anonymous will live on.
sentences.zh: 而这些图标和“匿名者”将继续存在下去。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible was produced this week by Rob Walker and me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 本周的《99% Invisible》由罗伯·沃克和我，罗曼·马尔斯共同制作。

sentences.en: It's based off an article that Rob wrote for Slate.
sentences.zh: 它基于罗伯为《Slate》杂志撰写的一篇文章。

sentences.zh: 我会在网站上提供链接。
